description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'PurgeServiceTest' for testing the 'PurgeService' in the OrangeHRM system. It includes various test methods to verify purging functionalities for employee and candidate data, strategy handling, and exception cases within the HRM's maintenance service layer.

classes.name: PurgeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'PurgeService', including methods to verify data purging, strategy handling, and exception flowing for employee and candidate data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating the 'PurgeService' and populating the database with fixture data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePurgeDao
methods.description: Tests that 'getPurgeDao' returns an instance of 'PurgeDao'.

methods.name: testGetPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Verifies the list and keys of entities that are deemed purgeable under a specific strategy.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Checks that 'getPurgeStrategy' returns an instance of 'ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy' with correct match-by and parameters.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy2
methods.description: Checks that 'getPurgeStrategy' returns an instance of 'DestroyPurgeStrategy' with correct match-by and null parameters.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Performs a purge operation on employee data and verifies that the employee and related entities are reset to 'purged' states or emptied.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures that a transaction exception is correctly thrown when 'getPurgeableEntities' raises an exception during employee data purge.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy1
methods.description: Verifies purging candidate data where candidates have not consented to keep their data for vacancy 1.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy2
methods.description: Verifies purging candidate data for vacancy 2 where candidates have consented to keep their data.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy3
methods.description: Verifies data retention when no candidates applied for vacancy 3.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy4
methods.description: Verifies partial data removal for candidates with mixed consent for vacancy 4.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy5
methods.description: Verifies complete removal of candidate 8's data after interview process for vacancy 5.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures that transaction exceptions propagate correctly during candidate data purging.
